mapper.select: SELECT count(1) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND ( ETRS_MTCD = '01' OR (ETRS_MTCD = '02' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= SYSTIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01', MOD_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MOD_ID = #{mod_id} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND ( ETRS_MTCD = '01' OR (ETRS_MTCD = '02' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= SYSTIMESTAMP) ) AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_MST_NO AS MSGID, 'AT' AS MSGTYPE, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS MSG, CASE WHEN RECEIVER_PHONE_NO LIKE '82%' THEN RECEIVER_PHONE_NO WHEN RECEIVER_PHONE_NO LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO, 2,15) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO, 2,15) END AS PHN, BROF_CD AS PINVOICE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, MSG_TEMPLATE_CD AS TMPLID, CASE WHEN ETRS_MTCD = '01' THEN '00000000000000' WHEN ETRS_MTCD = '02' THEN SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME ELSE '00000000000000' END AS RESERVEDT, '${profile_key}' AS PROFILEKEY, AD_FLAG AS ADFLAG, CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 1) IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT( 'type' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 1), 'name' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_NAME, '[^|]+', 1, 1), 'url_pc' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_PC_IOS, '[^|]+', 1, 1), 'url_mobile' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_MOBILE_ANDROID, '[^|]+', 1, 1) ) ELSE NULL END AS BUTTON1, CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 2) IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT( 'type' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 2), 'name' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_NAME, '[^|]+', 1, 2), 'url_pc' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_PC_IOS, '[^|]+', 1, 2), 'url_mobile' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_MOBILE_ANDROID, '[^|]+', 1, 2) ) ELSE NULL END AS BUTTON2, CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 3) IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT( 'type' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 3), 'name' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_NAME, '[^|]+', 1, 3), 'url_pc' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_PC_IOS, '[^|]+', 1, 3), 'url_mobile' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_MOBILE_ANDROID, '[^|]+', 1, 3) ) ELSE NULL END AS BUTTON3, CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 4) IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT( 'type' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 4), 'name' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_NAME, '[^|]+', 1, 4), 'url_pc' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_PC_IOS, '[^|]+', 1, 4), 'url_mobile' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_MOBILE_ANDROID, '[^|]+', 1, 4) ) ELSE NULL END AS BUTTON4, CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 5) IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT( 'type' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_TYPE, '[^|]+', 1, 5), 'name' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(BUTTON_NAME, '[^|]+', 1, 5), 'url_pc' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_PC_IOS, '[^|]+', 1, 5), 'url_mobile' VALUE REGEXP_SUBSTR(URL_MOBILE_ANDROID, '[^|]+', 1, 5) ) ELSE NULL END AS BUTTON5 FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01'
